notes.title: Development Progress - December 2023 (Merry Christmas!)
notes.content:
I appreciate the trust of those who have purchased the [b]Early Access[/b] version so far, it has been a very difficult year for me, in the coming weeks the project will be at a slower pace as I am prioritizing other work that is giving me more immediate financial return, as unfortunately [i]Resultarias[/i] is not yet my main source of income.

I ask for patience until I recover and can return to working on the project with more time.

[h3]Here are the highlights of what I did in the last updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added icon that shows if you are trying to move the camera in a location where the camera is fixed.
[*] Fixed collision issue in some scenarios.
[*] The item [b]Machado[/b] was included and improved, although not yet finalized.
[/list]
I continue to interact with people on [url=https://discord.gg/TSX6DBnS5A]Discord[/url], feel free to come and chat! Thanks to everyone who is helping me with translation and testing.

[h3]Featured community videos:[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=17NxbeiPA_c
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Nbq5nC2L78g

[h3]I'm adding everyone I find [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLCEiu1MjiAUlSItohWps-EJs12pPg2uDA]to this playlist[/url]![/h3]

[h1]Merry Christmas![/h1]

notes.title: July 2023 Progress Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/754ffef01913b897cd2c8ef59ee465a566c01655.png[/img]
I changed the rendering while Utsuki in in the Dream World to a more stylized shading with some nice color banding, this reminds of an aesthetic of old games where the amount of colors was very limited. Old horror games had an special look because of this, cause shadows looked somehow “corrupted”, and then darker scenarios on Resultarias now looks more threatening.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/9830559cfd6364cc8b6f39abc6d9c7801d441654.png[/img]
I started creating a Tutorial level but I am not satisfied with what I did so far, I will return to this level in the future when the game core mechanics are more complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/9e56bd8947984077ffb416218f01689636371453.png[/img]
Unfortunately, Resultarias is not my main source of income, so I always have to work on it in my free time. 

I am glad for all the people that bought the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230030]Early Access[/url] version of the game, that helps me a lot. 

The game has 800 wishlists here now, that's a very big number for me, I am happy for it. Thank you for everyone support so far, I am working hard to bring more content to the game as soon as possible.

notes.title: 0.8 rework and new content
notes.content:
[h2]Main Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Utsuki clothes colors and shader got reworked to better match her color pallet.
[*] Jumping now keeps momentum, better for exploration.
[*] Kitty can be grabbed now, not only cute but it can help navigation in dangerous and dark scenarios.
[*] Radio Item reworked to only turn on and off. The game propose to not have dialog and the radio had, so I remove the "Look through radio stations" system.
[/list]

[h2]Other improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed all "invisible walls", now map limits are set in a more creative way.
[*] Nightmares can be completed.
[*] Falling from high heights in sand or snow doesn't kill Utsuki.
[*] Gnome Forest got included in the game, even though not complete, only a sneak peak.
[*] The Yellowrooms size got reduced and more content included to reduce time wandering arround.
[*] More content revealed with the Neon Outfit.
[*] A lot of fixes and improvements, like optimizations and better Joystick support.
[/list]

[h2]Alpha access[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/514eadf1857391eb4dddf09fa01725bff476d938.png[/img]
Alpha version is a benefit of those who purchased the game, providing the opportunity to explore its unique features and contribute valuable feedback. Please note that the Alpha version is a work in progress, and get updated frequently (almost daily).

Keep in mind that a lot of content will be replaced and may be reworked, and there is a lot of things to finish.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43457474/3ee453511ea8f4c0a0ab6a493cca740746e20728.png[/img][list]
[*] Desert has new characters, improved landscape and you can enter the pyramid now!
[*] New Door leading to Underwater world
[*] Overall shaders improved, gold shader improved.
[*] When taking too much time loading a map, a progress bar will be shown in the middle of the screen.
[*] Other improvements and small changes in origami scenario and yellow rooms.
[/list]

- Improved inventory management on Controllers.
- Inventory now shows the total number of items available in the game.
- Fixed bug where you could Pet the Cat while running.
- Fixed bug where the radio sometimes was not [spoiler]detecting nearby danger[/spoiler].

[list]
[*] Included new character that can appears on maps. 
[*] Changed Cat color to be a little bit more visible on white scenarios.
[/list]

Hotfix for a issue reported on Resultarias Discord: menu broken +  blackscreen after wake up from dying.

Sorry for this, and thanks for Kurikuo for the report.

Join the [url= https://discord.gg/TSX6DBnS5A]Resultarias Discord[/url] to get along with the community, report bugs and make suggestions!

Link: https://discord.gg/TSX6DBnS5A

Pet the cat is back, fixed stuck in new game, fixed Discord rich presence, changed footstep sounds on origami world, frog now flies with Utsuki above it again, Desert effect when too far from center, Ness Lake improvements, increased overall footsteps, improved movement on Low gravity scenarios, fix camera inside Utsuki on Nightmares scenarios, Yellow Rooms reduced and improved Level Design, revealed objects on Party Area
